candidates.term: The Horizon at the Hour Gate
candidates.defline: The Horizon stands at your Hour Gate, in plain view: people see your later years as busy with new chances and new ventures.
candidates.reading: In later life younger people seek you out, because you keep finding openings long after most people have settled. Since a fresh start keeps you sharp, you take on a new field or a new venture when others your age are winding down. The people after you, children or younger relatives or someone you train, get more of your time and money than you planned. You are remembered for what you started more than for what you kept.
candidates.teaser: You will stay opportunity’s friend to the end: late ventures, late windfalls, a wide door. Leave the estate mapped, because your generosity will outrun your paperwork.

domain_readings.Wealth: Your money stays lively to the end: late ventures, late windfalls, a door that never fully closes. The estate needs a map early, because your generosity will outrun your paperwork by a decade. Write it down while it is easy. Then keep playing. You are built for a wide ending.
domain_readings.Growth: Late growth arrives through new fields: ventures entered past the age of supposed settling, younger company keeping your range honest. The horizon habit is your youth serum. Enter one unfamiliar arena per era. Curiosity is the muscle, and yours refuses to atrophy.

candidates.life_chapter: Your late chapter keeps the door open: opportunity stays your friend past every retirement age, and the last decades run wide, peopled, and in motion. Expect to be the elder with the newest stories. Map the estate early, then spend the rest of the era collecting more.
candidates.relations: The young and venturesome are this seat’s people: proteges with prospects, late friendships across generations, heirs who inherit your range. They keep your horizon honest and your calendar full. Back them with numbers attached. Patronage papered is patronage sustained.
candidates.turn_catalyst: Run thin, the door drifts shut: range intact, ventures postponed. Open one this year, sized kindly. The chapter stays wide only in use.
candidates.turn_friction: Run heavy, the openness leaks: every prospect funded, every trip taken. Map the estate first. Then wander freely.
candidates.shadow_line: Overloaded, the horizon never lands: motion to the end, arrival never scheduled.
candidates.health_line: Your late vitality feeds on novelty and company: new places, young voices, plans in the calendar. Stillness is the only ailment to dodge.

Wealth.headline: Your money comes in through side doors.
Wealth.recognition: You notice a chance to earn where others see an ending, a venture someone else gave up on or a deal nobody followed up. Because new money excites you more than kept money, you move it on to the next opening and write down too little of it. You carry your plans in your head far longer than you put them on paper.
Wealth.lived: In your Late Chapter money has reached you through doors you had stopped watching, late ventures and deals brought by people a generation younger. You have built a wide spread of small ventures in place of one steady income, each one opened on a hunch.
Wealth.ahead: From your late forties chances to earn keep arriving from far outside your usual circle, through new projects and through the people after you. You say yes to more of them than anyone your age, happiest when the offer comes from furthest away.

Growth.headline: Every fresh start widens your world.
Growth.recognition: You widen your range whenever life allows, a new field or a new place or a crowd you know nothing about. Because being a beginner keeps you awake and curious, a life that only repeats itself bores you within months. You surprise the people around you with how many times you begin again.
Growth.lived: In your Late Chapter you have kept moving, into new work, new places and friendships with people much younger. You have come out of each move more curious than people your age, and less settled than anyone expected.
Growth.ahead: Your world gets wider from your late forties, through travel and through work in places that are new to you. You become the one in your family with the newest stories, and the most open to the next change.
